activePlan.objective: Fix a real Windows CI failure introduced by the pre-push-hook commit (48db90f): test/installGitHooks.test.js asserted an exact 0o755 filesystem mode after chmodSync, but Windows/NTFS has no POSIX executable bit, so the real result there is 0o666, never 0o755.
steps: Confirm the failure via the Windows job logs (438 !== 493, i.e. 0o666 vs 0o755) for jobs windows-latest/22 and windows-latest/24.

Make the two exact-mode assertions in test/installGitHooks.test.js conditional on process.platform !== 'win32', matching this codebase's existing convention for Windows-specific behavior differences elsewhere in the suite.
Keep asserting result.installed === true (and core.hooksPath) on every platform; only the literal filesystem-mode check is skipped on Windows.
Run the full local suite plus lint:workflows, docs:check, validate, and the three fast audits before pushing.

completed: Made the exact-0o755 assertions in test/installGitHooks.test.js platform-conditional (skipped on win32), since fs.chmodSync cannot set true POSIX executable bits on Windows/NTFS.
Both affected tests still assert installGitHooks() reported success on every platform, including Windows.
verification: lint:workflows, docs:check, validate, audit:clutter, audit:privacy, and audit:security all pass against the current staged snapshot.
remaining: Push to development, then confirm Self-Test is green on ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, and macos-latest for the new commit, plus AI handoff policy, AI conflict governance, and CodeQL.
No default-branch or repository-setting change involved; nothing further requires owner authorization.
